name: WF UI Map
description: Workflow-canvas awareness and control commands for PTY agent nodes.

commands.name: self
commands.description: Print this PTY node's session id, runtime, agent kind, workflow mode, graph node id, and map path.

commands.name: describe
commands.description: Describe the current workflow graph from the wf-ui snapshot when available, or from Harness/a2a workflow-map files.

commands.name: snapshot
commands.description: Read the complete workflow snapshot for routing and graph-state decisions.

commands.name: create-agent
commands.description: Main Agent only. Create a managed PTY node in the Workflow canvas through the wf-ui backend.

commands.name: send-input
commands.description: Main Agent only. Send terminal input to a connected managed PTY node and record a wf-bridge message.

commands.name: bridge-messages
commands.description: Main Agent only. Read the recorded wf-bridge conversation between two managed sessions.

commands.name: connect
commands.description: Main Agent only. Add a wf-bridge edge to the workflow graph.

commands.name: delete-node
commands.description: Main Agent only. Remove a saved workflow graph node while preserving transcript history.
